messages:
Maya Chen: flagging a billing delta after an ACME replay job. ingest shows ~39,812 embeds for 2024-11-12T08:00-09:00, billing only recorded ~34,760. ~5k missing. any ideas?
Ben Park: which replay job id and target shard?
Maya Chen: job_id=job_20241112_0813, primary shard=shard-12. there was a shard split and a spillover to shard-9. logs: `ingest_offsets=2300450-2307000`
Olivia Ruiz: billing is derived from ack_ledger writes. if ack writes failed during the reconciler run we often see this pattern. did the embed-ack-reconciler finish cleanly?
Maya Chen: reconciler ran but surfaced ~5k constraint errors: `ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "ack_ledger_pkey"` for many event_ids. stacktrace shows inserts failing at billing-db layer.
Nate Singh: duplicate key implies the reconciler attempted an insert of an event_id already present. were replayed messages preserving original event ids? we deprecated the `-replay` suffix last month.
Ben Park: confirmed the replay tool no longer adds suffix. replay + original inflight messages can produce duplicate event ids when shard splits cause retries. reconciler logic was older and used plain INSERT, not upsert.
Olivia Ruiz: short-term fix: upsert the failing keys into ack_ledger so billing joins succeed. long-term: make reconciler idempotent with `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` and add a dedupe at ingestion.
Maya Chen: for invoice safety, can finance accept a recount based on indexed embeds rather than ledger rows? example query: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM embeds WHERE customer_id='ACME' AND indexed_at BETWEEN '2024-11-12T08:00:00Z' AND '2024-11-12T09:00:00Z' AND status='indexed';`
finance-bot: reminder — ACME has an active dispute on invoice 2024-11-ACME-09. tag applied. :warning:
Ben Park: extracting failing event_ids from reconciler logs and preparing an upsert script. will test in staging. ETA ~90m.
Nate Singh: also inspect S3 replay manifests — I've seen cases where the replay tool emits duplicate messages when manifests overlap during split. log snip: `WARN duplicate message id: evt_8a72d1`
Maya Chen: I'll run `replay_tool --job job_20241112_0813 --shard shard-12 --dry-run --print-ids | sort | uniq -c | grep -v " 1 "` to spot duplicates locally.
Olivia Ruiz: finance prefers reconciliation to finish within 24h to avoid provisional credits. if we can't finish, we'll place a hold and do manual adjustment later.
Ben Park: running upsert now in prod with: `INSERT INTO ack_ledger (customer_id,event_id,acked_at) VALUES (...) ON CONFLICT (customer_id,event_id) DO NOTHING;` will push presence without changing existing timestamps. starting in 10m.
ingest-bot: Note — reconciler service updated in release 2024.11.12-patch1 to use upsert by Ben Park.
Ben Park: upsert completed. attempted 5,032 rows, all present afterwards, 0 failures.
Maya Chen: re-run billing recount. new count: 39,814 vs ingest 39,816. within 2 records. closing with ACME; will note in ticket.
Olivia Ruiz: filing follow-up JIRA FIN-8421 to add ingest-side dedupe and e2e test for replay+shard-split. tagging engineering and finance.
Nate Singh: proposal: short-lived shard Bloom filter in consumer to catch immediate duplicates post-replay. low CPU/memory and should catch most cases.
Maya Chen: thanks everyone. attaching logs and replay diff outputs to the ticket. :thumbsup:
